div.head: Iudex 15.1
div.ab: Scriptum est: Non attendas personam hominis in indicio, nec pro aliquo facies, ut a nero denies et iniuste iudices!
Hyt ys awriten: ‘Ne onfoh ðu nænigne had on dome; né ne ara ðú for nanum, þæt þu þæt riht ne deme’.
Es steht geschrieben: ‘Nicht begünstige du irgend eine Person im Urtheilspruch und um Keines willen schone unterlassend, den richtigen Spruch zu ertheilen’.
It is written: ‘Do not favour any person in judgment, and for no one's sake be lenient so as to fail to give the right judgment’.
It is written: “Don’t look (over-)favourably upon any individual, nor give honour to any (in such a way) that justice is not served.
